name: A small building on a rocky hillside, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a hillside building whose extended roof is supported by wooden props; a tree is growing out from the stonework beneath the road.  For other drawings of the same building see E.2149-1928 and E.2159-1928.
